metadata.purpose: Test F-interchangeability across maximally diverse processing regimes
design_notes: Each group contains 4 variants that should elicit long (64+ token) continuations
Groups are organized into REGIMES that differ in fundamental processing mode
Within-regime F-swaps test interchangeability within a processing mode
Cross-regime F-swaps test whether F is truly universal or regime-specific
All prompts tested against Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for baseline viability

regimes.english_analytical: groups 04-06: Analytical/expository English requiring extended reasoning
regimes.romance_language: groups 07-09: Spanish, French, Portuguese narrative openers
regimes.east_asian: groups 10-12: Mandarin, Japanese, Korean prompts (test model competence first)
regimes.code_completion: groups 13-15: Python, JavaScript, Rust incomplete functions
regimes.unusual_register: groups 20-21: Legal, archaic, stream-of-consciousness, highly technical
